chunks: And through its chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), he said:
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'One who loves you loves me, and one who despises you despises me. [And one who despises me, God despises him].'

key_terms.مُبْغِضُ اللَّهِ: The enemy of God / One whom God despises

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of loving Imam Ali in Shia theology?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, establishes the principle of *al-Wala' wa al-Bara'* (loyalty and enmity) by linking the Prophet’s spiritual identity directly to Imam Ali (AS). It underscores that love for the Ahl al-Bayt is not merely affection but a theological imperative, serving as a criterion for true adherence to the Prophet’s message.
